Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.v20260728

Class McpResourceServerConfig

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.v20260728.McpResourceServerConfig
public class McpResourceServerConfig extends Object
Binding-owned OAuth 2.1 resource-server (RS) configuration for a 2026-07-28 MCP endpoint — the F2 authorization-hardening baseline (READY-312f).

Off by default. isEnabled() is false unless enabled, so an existing MCP endpoint that does not opt in behaves exactly as before (no bearer requirement, no well-known route). When enabled, the endpoint:

  • Requires a valid RFC 6750 bearer token on the MCP POST endpoint, establishing an authenticated principal.
  • Serves an RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata document from .well-known/oauth-protected-resource.
  • Answers a missing/invalid token with 401 + a WWW-Authenticate: Bearer ... challenge carrying the resource_metadata pointer.
  • Enforces RFC 8707 audience matching against the resource identifier.

Mutable during setup, effectively immutable once published — the same builder-less mutable-setup idiom as McpMrtrConfig / McpCacheConfig: configure it fully via the createMcpOptions() / getMcpOptions() override, then never mutate it afterward (a request-time reader sees it with no synchronization).

Token-validation mode:

The validation mode (RFC 7662 introspection vs JWKS/issuer JWT verification) is selected by which TokenValidator is supplied to setTokenValidator(TokenValidator): OAuthIntrospectionValidator (from juneau-rest-server-auth-oauth) for opaque tokens, or JwtTokenValidator (from juneau-rest-server-auth-jwt) for JWT access tokens.

Since:
10.0.0

    • isRequireAudienceClaim

      public boolean isRequireAudienceClaim()
      Whether a validated token must expose audience claims for RFC 8707 audience enforcement to apply (READY-312f F2, H2).

      When true (the default), a validator that returns a bare Principal carrying no claims is rejected (401 invalid_token) rather than silently passing the confused-deputy defense. Set to false only when the token validator itself enforces the audience internally (e.g. a JwtTokenValidator configured to verify aud) so a claims-less principal is a deliberate, trusted signal — pairs with introspection-mode validators that legitimately omit aud.

      Returns:
      true if a claims-less principal is rejected (the default).

    • addOperationScope

      public McpResourceServerConfig addOperationScope(String method, String name, String... scopes)
      Registers the scopes required to invoke a specific MCP operation (SEP-2350 per-operation step-up).

      Populates the default static per-operation scope map consulted by requiredScopesFor(McpOperationContext) when no explicit resolver is set. A null or blank name registers a method-wide entry matching every operation of that JSON-RPC method (e.g. every tools/call regardless of tool name); a specific name takes precedence over the method-wide entry. Each supplied scope is also advertised as supported.

      Parameters:
      method - The JSON-RPC method (e.g. tools/call). Must not be null or blank.
      name - The operation name (tool/prompt name or resource URI), or null/blank for a method-wide entry.
      scopes - The scopes required to invoke the operation. Must not be null, empty, or contain a null/blank element.
      Returns:
      This object (for method chaining).
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If method is null/blank or scopes is invalid.

    • setOperationScopeResolver

      public McpResourceServerConfig setOperationScopeResolver(McpOperationScopeResolver value)
      Installs a dynamic per-operation scope resolver, overriding the default static map.

      The seam for a future dynamic resolver (READY-312f Q-c); not built for 10.0. When set, it fully replaces the static map for requiredScopesFor(McpOperationContext).

      Parameters:
      value - The resolver, or null to revert to the static map.
      Returns:
      This object (for method chaining).

    • requiredScopesFor

      public Set<String> requiredScopesFor(McpOperationContext ctx)
      Resolves the scopes required to invoke the given operation (SEP-2350).

      Consults the resolver when installed; otherwise the static map, preferring a name-specific entry over the method-wide "*" entry. An empty return means "no per-operation requirement beyond the endpoint-wide baseline".

      Parameters:
      ctx - The resolved operation. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      The required scopes (never null; possibly empty).

    • validateEnabled

      public void validateEnabled()
      Validates that this config is internally consistent for the enabled state.

      A no-op when disabled. When enabled, requires a resource identifier (absolute, with scheme + authority) and a token validator.

      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - If enabled but misconfigured.
